title: Reconstruction of a normalized tower
statement:
Let $C_\bullet\in\Dctf(T_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E/\ell^\bullet)$ be normalized
([sk-def-sp-normalized-towers]). Then $R\varprojlim_n C_n$ lies in
$\Dbc(T,\mathcal O_E)$, and for every $m$ the natural map

$$
\bigl(R\varprojlim_n C_n\bigr)\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_{E,T}}
\mathcal O_{E,T}/\ell^m\longrightarrow C_m
$$

is an isomorphism in $D(T_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E/\ell^m)$.

proof.text: For every finite exponent apply the projection finite-reduction theorem; it needs normalization but no constructibility. Obtain the resulting canonical finite-level isomorphisms.

Choose the common Tor interval [c,d] from hC. Transport constructible cohomology and that interval from C_n to the derived ell-power reductions of M through the inverses of those canonical isomorphisms. Apply cofinal integral reduction bounds to get constructible uniformizer reductions, all vanishing outside [c,d].

Completeness holds for any completed coefficient-tower Roos limit. Each uniformizer reduction has support contained in the finite integer interval [c,d], hence has finite cohomological support. These witnesses are exactly sfIntegralConstructible; pair this with the finite projection isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Lean assembly of projection comparison, completeness, and cofinal uniformizer bounds. Explicit transport and finite-support construction.
